body.p: A program trial method includes: displaying a user interface of a host program; displaying a first image frame of a cloud application on the user interface of the host program in response to a trial event being triggered, the first image frame being obtained based on a first output of the cloud application loaded with a trial setting; and displaying a second image frame of the cloud application on the user interface of the host program, the second image frame being obtained based on a second output of the cloud application in response to an operation performed on the user interface.
